BiblicalUsage: God says He will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow. Jeremiah says the Lord has swallowed up Israel, and has increased mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah. The word is mourning, grieving: the sound of a city under judgment, and a people under sorrow.
TheologicalSignificance: Mourning runs in both directions in these two verses, I believe: God brings it as judgment, and His people feel it as grief, and the prophet names both without flinching.
